posts.cooked:
The editor’s note which corresponds to the number of hero decks in the original game! (The next EN gives us Alpha, and then there’s one or two for Darkstryfe and Painstake, and that’s it.)

I definitely don’t share Christopher’s opinion that creativity is draining. I find it basically effortless. Getting paid for it is another story of course.

I wonder if Gargoyle’s civilian alias is Gary G. Foyle or Garfield Boyle.

So this episode is the source for saying “there is only one ‘the Void’, but it has unique presentation to each timeline”, which is unlike either the Realm of Discord or Ur-Space. This is what I remembered being true while I Justified, and I was very surprised by an earlier episodes contradicting that, saying “every timeline has a separate Realm of Discord, every timeline has its own separate Void”. That didn’t make sense to me. Gloomweaver is infinite voodoo shamans who did infinite rituals to transcend infinite mortal bodies to become infinite alligator-tailed nightmare gods; I’m fine with all that. But there was probably only one original Akash’Bhuta, who stepped out infinite Nexi of the Void and became the slumbering malevolence of infinite planet Earths.

Advice to the Vertex people: “DON’T USE THE OBLIVION SHARDS! SERIOUSLY DON’T DO IT! NO, NOT EVEN YOU, WORST VILLAIN EVER MAN! IT’S NOT WORTH IT EVEN FOR YOU!!!”

Since they talked about the realm of the Fey, who are at this point explicitly established as being “little people” (I don’t know if that remains true for the RCR Fey Court deck), obligatory plug for the absolute best song ever sung about a tiny bit powerful being, “The Wee Wee Man” by Steeleye Span."

“Stopping Terrorism” - Adam says “you don’t like the acronym that comes up with.” I’m pretty sure Christopher does like that acronym, in exactly the way he likes to swear a lot, and has to stop…I mean, limit himself from doing it in the air, or else Trevor has to bleep him.

Technically naked Galactra confirmed. I am so happy.
